Guillermo's own take for Tue, Nov 3 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Pam Rocks woke up: N 17 at 6am, N 25 at 7am. The page now has Porteau at NNE 21 with about 3ft of swell from 8 to 10:30am, shutting off by 11.

Porteau may be the call, but the window may be short, so go now. The tide floods from 5.6ft at 6:54am toward 15.2ft at 2:21pm, which can flatten the swell. If Pam Rocks drops under 22 at 8 or 9am, turn around. On Sunday the cove had only 5 with Pam Rocks at 24, so look before you rig.

Wind northerly outflow 15 to 25 knots diminishing to northerly outflow 10 to 15 near noon then increasing to northerly outflow 20 Wednesday morning. Wind diminishing to light near noon Wednesday.
